fusions.name: Musk Line
fusions.desc: Sprays a 4-tile line of musk ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 10 poison damage to each enemy that crosses it, chokes it into a 0.8 second stun and leaves it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Reminder
fusions.desc: A jet that deals 9 poison damage to the first enemy it meets. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Hands Off
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Never Twice
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, a jet strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 6 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
